Diagram of a complex ion, tetraamminecopper(II) ion. A central Cu2+ ion is surrounded by four NH3 molecules arranged in a square plane. An arrow points from the nitrogen atom of each NH3 molecule to the central Cu2+ ion, representing the donation of a lone pair of electrons (coordinate bond). The entire structure is enclosed in large square brackets with a "2+" charge outside.

Diagram of a Blast Furnace. A tall tapering tower structure. At the top, a hopper feeds in 'Iron ore, Coke, Limestone'. An exhaust pipe at the top lets out 'Waste gases (CO2, N2)'. Near the bottom, pipes blow in 'Hot air blast'. Inside, label three temperature zones: top (about 400°C), middle (about 1000°C), bottom (about 1500°C). At the very bottom, two separate tap-holes: the upper one drains 'Molten slag', the lower one drains 'Molten iron'.

Flow diagram of CuSO4 crystal preparation. Panel 1: A beaker on a tripod over a Bunsen burner, a spatula adding black CuO powder into dilute H2SO4. Panel 2: The mixture being filtered through a filter funnel lined with filter paper into a conical flask; black solid stays in the paper, blue liquid drips through. Panel 3: The blue liquid in an evaporating dish being heated gently. Panel 4: The dish removed from heat, showing bright blue diamond-shaped crystals forming.
